description:
We are a creative and ambitious team passionate about space exploration, AI, technology, and game development. Our goal is to build an immersive space mission game that combines exploration, strategy, and innovation. We welcome motivated people who want to learn, collaborate, and create something meaningful.

Looking for: Unity/C# developers, 3D artists, UI/UX designers, AI programmers, game designers, and space science enthusiasts. All skill levels are welcome!
summary:
Moonbase HDR is an interactive 3D space exploration and lunar base simulation project developed by Team FRATRES FIDELITATIS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The project aims to make space engineering more accessible through an immersive simulation where players explore an extraterrestrial environment, operate a research outpost, monitor essential resources, and interact with engineering systems.

The current prototype features procedurally generated terrain, a research habitat, solar panels, a controllable rover, resource monitoring, life-support mechanics, and regolith collection through a drilling system.

By connecting exploration with resource management and engineering concepts, Moonbase HDR demonstrates some of the challenges involved in establishing and maintaining a sustainable extraterrestrial research base.

Our long-term vision is to expand the prototype into a comprehensive space mission simulation, incorporating mission planning, infrastructure development, scientific operations, and interconnected engineering systems.
details:
MoonBase: Mission Architect

MoonBase: Mission Architect is an educational space exploration and lunar base simulation project designed to introduce users to the engineering challenges of establishing and maintaining a human presence on the Moon.

The project focuses on the construction and management of a lunar base. Players can explore a simulated lunar environment, interact with a habitat, operate a rover, and use drilling systems to explore and collect resources. The simulation also introduces essential base-management concepts, including oxygen, water, battery power, and crew health. These systems demonstrate how different resources are interconnected and why careful planning is essential for long-term lunar operations.

Our project aims to make complex space engineering concepts more accessible and interactive. Instead of only reading about lunar missions, users can experience the challenges of operating a lunar settlement and understand the importance of resource management, infrastructure, mobility, and environmental conditions.

The prototype is designed using Unity 6 and the Universal Render Pipeline (URP), with C# scripts supporting its simulation systems. It incorporates a procedurally generated lunar terrain, a lunar habitat, rover concepts, drilling equipment, a simplified lunar gravity model of 1.62 m/s², and a solar day-and-night cycle.

Installation and Launch Instructions

The project files are provided in a compressed ZIP package. To access the Unity project:

1. Download the project ZIP package from the provided project link.

2. Extract the ZIP archive into a folder on your computer.

3. Install Unity Hub and the compatible Unity 6 Editor version.

4. Open Unity Hub and select Add Project or Open.

5. Select the extracted project folder containing the Unity project files.

6. Allow Unity to import the project and its assets.

7. Open the project in the Unity Editor. If the project opens successfully, select the appropriate scene from the Scenes folder and use the Play button to explore the prototype.

Important: This submission provides a Unity project package, not a verified standalone executable. Successful compilation and Play Mode execution have not been independently verified on every system.

Project Documentation

The accompanying PDF demonstration document provides an overview of the project’s concept, systems, design, and development approach. To open it, download the PDF and open it using a web browser or a PDF reader such as Adobe Acrobat Reader. The PDF is documentation and does not launch the game.

Tools and Technologies

* Unity 6

* Universal Render Pipeline (URP)

* C#

* 3D environment and terrain systems

* Resource and base-management simulation concepts

The creative aspect of our project is the combination of space exploration, engineering, and resource management in an interactive educational experience. Our team considered important lunar mission constraints, including limited resources, environmental conditions, energy availability, and the operational needs of a future lunar settlement.

MoonBase: Mission Architect is intended to encourage interest in aerospace engineering, planetary science, robotics, and space exploration while helping students understand the complexity of planning and sustaining missions beyond Earth.
